signup.question: How do I create an account?
signup.answer: Click Get started or Create free account on the landing page. You can register with email, phone, or both. You must accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. An invitation code is optional and links you to the member who invited you.

login.question: How do I log in?
login.answer: Use Log in from the top menu. Sign in with your username, email, or phone plus your password. After login you'll land on your dashboard.

payments.question: How do crypto payments work?
payments.answer: Go to New deposit, enter the USD amount, pick network and token, then create the request. Open the payment card to connect your wallet and pay, or copy the deposit address and send from any wallet — use the correct network only. Keep the page open; it refreshes until confirmed. Your USD balance is credited after confirmation.

networks.question: Which networks are supported?
networks.answer: StackPay supports major EVM networks including Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, and Sepolia testnet. Payments and withdrawals use the network you select for each request.

packages.question: How do investment packages work?
packages.answer: Put your USD balance into tiered investment packages to earn daily income. Open Packages, choose a tier and amount within the limits, confirm, then track active investments and income in Package portfolio. Package earnings go to your main USD balance and can be withdrawn.

mining.question: How does cloud mining work?
mining.answer: Open Mining, pick a plan, and start a session with your USD balance (some plans may be free). Mining runs for a set session length (often 24 hours), then stops — you can start again. Mining income goes to a separate mining balance that is not withdrawable like package USD. Track sessions in Mining portfolio.

overview.question: What can I do in StackPay?
overview.answer: 1) Deposit crypto to fund your USD balance. 2) Grow with investment packages (withdrawable income) or cloud mining (mining balance). 3) Transfer USD to other members instantly. 4) Withdraw USDC/USDT to your wallet. 5) Borrow against active packages. 6) Invite friends for referral commissions. 7) Chat in Community. Use the sidebar menu to open each section.

settings.question: Where do I change language or profile?
settings.answer: Open Settings from the sidebar to update your profile, avatar, and language (English, French, Swahili). You can also install StackPay as a mobile app from your browser.

withdraw.question: How do withdrawals work?
withdraw.answer: Withdraw your USD balance as USDC or USDT to your crypto wallet on supported networks. You can save your wallet address for faster future withdrawals. Minimum and maximum limits apply and are shown in the withdraw section.

transfer.question: Can I transfer to other users?
transfer.answer: Yes. StackPay supports instant internal transfers between members. Send USD balance to another StackPay user from the transfer page — no blockchain fees for internal moves.

referrals.question: How does the referral program work?
referrals.answer: Every member gets a personal invite code and link. When someone you invited makes their first package investment, you earn a referral commission credited to your USD balance. Track invites and earnings on the referrals page.

loans.question: How do loans work?
loans.answer: Eligible members can borrow up to 75% of their active investment as a loan. Repayment is handled automatically from daily package earnings, with interest applied according to the loan terms shown in the app.

community.question: What is the community feature?
community.answer: StackPay includes community channels and direct messages so members can coordinate and stay connected. Profile images appear in chat, member lists, and referral teams.

mobile.question: Can I install StackPay on my phone?
mobile.answer:
Yes. StackPay is a progressive web app (PWA).

• iPhone (Safari): Share → Add to Home Screen → Add.
• Android (Chrome): Menu ⋮ → Install app / Add to Home screen.
• Desktop (Chrome/Edge): install icon in the address bar or browser menu.

You can also open Settings in the app for step-by-step install help. Installing gives you a home-screen icon, full screen, and better message badges.

balance.question: How does my USD balance work?
balance.answer: Your USD balance is the central wallet inside StackPay. Crypto payments, package income, referral commissions, loan activity, transfers, and withdrawals all flow through this single balance you can view anytime on the dashboard.

fees.question: Are there fees?
fees.answer: Internal transfers between StackPay members are free. Crypto network gas fees apply for on-chain deposits and withdrawals depending on the blockchain you use. Package and loan terms are shown before you confirm any action.

security.question: Is StackPay secure?
security.answer: Accounts use secure password hashing and session tokens. Each payment gets a unique deposit address. Never share your password or seed phrase. Only use official StackPay links and verify wallet addresses before sending crypto.

guide.question: Where is the user guide?
guide.answer: The free public user guide is at /guide on the StackPay website. It explains sign-up, payments, packages, withdrawals, referrals, loans, community, and more — no account or payment required. Developer API reference is separate at /docs.

support.question: How do I get human support?
support.answer: For general product questions, read the free user guide at /guide or keep chatting with this help bot. For account-specific help, sign in and reach out through community channels or your team contacts.

api.question: Where is the developer API documentation?
api.answer: StackPay developer documentation lives at /docs. The page is always visible, but the full REST and WebSocket reference unlocks after a one-time payment ($100 Individual / $250 Company in USDC on Polygon). Register on that page or ask the help bot there for step-by-step guidance.

terms.question: Where are the Terms and Privacy Policy?
terms.answer: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links are in the site footer. You must accept both when creating an account. Cookie preferences can be managed from the banner when you first visit.

apiUnlock.question: How do I unlock the API documentation?
apiUnlock.answer: Go to /docs on the StackPay website. Register with your name and email, choose Individual ($100) or Company ($250), then pay the exact USDC amount on Polygon to the deposit address shown. The full REST and WebSocket reference unlocks automatically after on-chain confirmation.

apiPricing.question: What does API access cost?
apiPricing.answer: API documentation unlock is a one-time payment: $100 USDC for Individual developers and $250 USDC for Company accounts. Payment is on Polygon only. This unlocks the full developer reference — it is separate from StackPay member accounts and investment packages.

apiPayment.question: How do I pay for developer access?
apiPayment.answer: After registering on /docs, copy the deposit address and send exactly the listed USDC amount on Polygon (not Ethereum mainnet). Keep this page open — it refreshes every 10 seconds and unlocks the docs when your payment confirms.

apiAuth.question: How do I authenticate API requests?
apiAuth.answer: Member endpoints require a JWT from POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register. Send Authorization: Bearer <token> on each request. Tokens expire after 7 days. Admin routes need a user with the ADMIN role.

why.label: Why StackPay
why.title: Why we built this app
why.subtitle: Most crypto tools stop at payments. StackPay connects funding, earning, community, and cash-out in one place — because growing balance should feel simple, social, and repeatable.

items.title: Crypto-native, not crypto-confusing
items.body: Pay with your crypto wallet, earn in USD balance, and withdraw stablecoins — without juggling five different apps.

items.title: Built to grow with your network
items.body: Packages, referrals, and loans connect into one flow so your earnings and your team scale together.

items.title: Transparent balance, one wallet
items.body: Payments, daily income, referral commissions, and loan activity all feed the same balance you can track anytime.

items.title: Community that keeps you in sync
items.body: Channels, DMs, and profile images help members coordinate, share wins, and stay active inside StackPay.

flow.label: The flow
flow.title: How StackPay works
flow.subtitle: From your first crypto deposit to daily earnings and withdrawal — every step is built into the platform.

items.title: Create your account
items.body: Sign up with email or phone. Optional invitation codes link you to the member who invited you.

items.title: Fund with crypto
items.body: Create a payment request, get a unique deposit address, and pay from any wallet on 7+ EVM networks.

items.title: Invest & earn daily
items.body: Choose an investment package, lock in your balance, and receive automated daily income to your wallet balance.

items.title: Grow your network
items.body: Share your invite link, earn commission when friends invest, and unlock loan eligibility as you build your team.

items.title: Withdraw or transfer
items.body: Cash out as USDC or USDT to your saved wallet address, or send USD balance instantly to another StackPay user.

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything in one app
features.subtitle: Payments, investing, referrals, loans, transfers, withdrawals, and community — designed to work together.

items.title: Crypto payments
items.body: Accept and send crypto from any wallet. Each payment gets a unique HD deposit address with automatic fund collection.

items.title: Investment packages
items.body: Put your USD balance into tiered packages and earn daily returns. Track active investments in your portfolio.

items.title: Withdraw to wallet
items.body: Convert balance to USDC or USDT on Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, or Avalanche. Your wallet address is saved for next time.

items.title: Instant transfers
items.body: Move USD balance to any StackPay member instantly — free internal transfers between accounts.

items.title: Invitation program
items.body: Every member gets a personal invite code. Earn commission when someone you invited makes their first package investment.

items.title: Loan program
items.body: Eligible members can borrow 75% of their active investment. Repayment happens automatically from daily earnings with 25% interest.

items.title: Community
items.body: Join channels, chat with members, send direct messages, and stay connected while you grow your balance.

items.title: Install as app
items.body: Add StackPay to your home screen on iPhone or Android. Full-screen, fixed layout — works like a native mobile app.

networks.label: Networks
networks.title: Multi-chain by default
networks.body: Pay and withdraw across major EVM networks. Each payment stores its chain and token — monitoring and payouts run on the correct network automatically.
